agents.stopping_reason: 12-batch ceiling (240 queries) reached; stopping criteria never triggered by yield (no three consecutive batches below 5 percent). Effective coverage for AGO went from 79.9 percent (544/681 months) to 99.7 percent (679/681). The single remaining gap, 2026-08-16..2026-09-21, was swept exhaustively in batches 7, 10 and 12 and is a publication lag, not a search failure: the newest Angolan cholera figure published anywhere as of 2026-09-21 is dated 12-15 August 2026.
gaps_filled: 1970-01-01..1970-12-31 documented absence (WER Cholera in 1971: Angola first notified cholera in 1971)
1976-01-01..1976-12-31 inferred absence, confidence 0.6 (WER 1977 comparators + GHO gap; non-reporting remains a live alternative)

1978-01-01..1986-12-31 the 3287-day dominant gap: nine per-year absence rows, eight Documented_Absence at 0.8 and 1982 upgraded to documented, each citing its own WER annual review, triangulated with the WER weekly IHR Infected Areas lists and with Frontiers in Microbiology 2013
1993 documented absence (WER Cholera in 1993 names Angola as reporting no cases)
2021 and 2024 documented absence (WER Tables 2, active zero reporting)
1992, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2016 national annual rows from the WHO GHO series
2017 national annual (828/43) and 2018 national annual (1546/25) from WER annual reviews - neither year exists in the GHO API series
2006 epidemic: dated WHO cumulative series (8 May, 16 May, 19 June), two single-day incidence points and derived provincial splits
2007 January-February (8039/257, UN CERF) and the 2006-2007 whole-wave cumulative (75627/2979, IFRC)

2025: full 18-province breakdowns at 10 May and 21 June from the WHO AFRO/MINSA weekly bulletins; September monthly national and provincial from the MINSA ministerial report; November and December national
2026: contiguous national series from January to 15 August, plus the first provincial rows for 2026 (April, May, January)
gaps_remaining: 2026-08-16..2026-09-21 (37 days stale): no source has published Angolan cholera data after 15 August 2026. WHO multi-country update #39, WHO AFRO weekly bulletin week 34+, and ECDC CDTR cholera entries after week 35 do not exist yet. Re-check after the next WHO AFRO weekly bulletin.

1976 remains inferred rather than documented. The one source that would settle it is Henriques FF, Alguns apontamentos estatisticos sobre a endemia da colera em Angola, Anais do Instituto de Higiene e Medicina Tropical (Lisbon) 1976; 4(1-4): 87-96 (PMID 1032481, Portuguese, print only). An IHMT/RUN repository or interlibrary request is needed.
Provincial detail for 1978-1996 does not exist in any accessible source.

Provincial tables in the MINSA numbered daily bulletins (Quadro 1) are embedded images and need OCR; the AFRO weekly bulletins for weeks 13, 15, 16 and 17 of 2025 are registered but not extracted - a clean vein for Agent 2.
